observations: RIME Figure 8 is identified as the current-mounted verso of the single joined Cat.1883 plus Cat.2095 five-fragment support; the TIFF is 6595 by 4710 pixels.

RIME 6 (2022), physical-description footnote 17, reports that earlier studies reversed the recto and verso labels. Historical Plate XXIX side labels therefore cannot be compared literally with modern mounting labels.

The Plate XXIX main Ramses panel has nine numbered rows, matching the published count for the RIME current-mounted verso; both have a royal-name/cartouche-like group at the first row. These are candidate-level visual cues, not a diagnostic sign sequence.
Plate XXIX is a historical illustration rather than a photograph, so papyrus-fiber detail cannot be compared. Shared support and candidate layout do not establish individual line identity.

The W10 box [2800,1690,6500,2020] remains an approximate envelope in original TIFF pixels. Page 41 numbered item 2 is an edition text-item locator, not a manuscript physical line number. No source transcription is copied.

historical_side_crosswalk.note: The published reversal resolves the nomenclature convention only. It does not independently prove that a particular illustrated panel or line is the same physical surface or line as a photographed region.

The drawing and photograph lack an independently established diagnostic stroke sequence and comparable fiber detail, so no numeric transform or physical line identity is asserted.

rationale: RIME 6 (2022), physical-description footnote 17, documents that earlier publications reversed recto and verso labels; after applying that source-attested convention, Plate XXIX main-panel recto nomenclature is compatible with the modern current-mounted verso label.

The historical main Ramses panel and the RIME current-mounted verso each have nine lines, and a royal-name/cartouche-like group appears in the first row of both. These observations make the panel a plausible candidate but do not establish line identity.

The Plate XXIX source is an illustration, not a photograph, and no independent diagnostic stroke sequence, fiber comparison, or expert review establishes exact correspondence. The result stays unresolved; zero gold and training admission remain blocked.
